kjv: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

lines.say: Before you lay it all down tonight, hear this.
lines.big: Before you lay it all down tonight, hear this

lines.say: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way,
lines.big: Rest in the LORD, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way,

lines.say: because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass. Psalm thirty seven, verse seven.
lines.big: because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

lines.say: You don't have to fix it tonight. Rest, and wait on him.
lines.big: You don't have to fix it tonight. Rest, and wait on him.

lines.say: Lord, I'm resting in you tonight. I'll wait on you. In Jesus' name, amen.
Want the Word playing while you sleep? Psalms 32 through 56, read slowly, is on our channel. The link is in the description.
